en.quote: A radical improvement in the quality and standard of living of Russian citizens, and the eradication of poverty as a social phenomenon.
en.head: Poverty remained widespread ten years later.
en.body: The party described overcoming poverty as part of a strategy for the next ten years. Rosstat counted 19.8 million people, or 13.5% of the population, below the poverty line in 2016. That is a substantial gap from the stated aim, although the document set no numerical test for success.
